name: OVHcloud VPS

evidence.vps: 03: one virtual machine with its own OS; the customer configures and maintains the guest OS and apps

line: Rent a virtual server and manage its operating system and apps.

cells.regions: Europe, North America and APAC; plan availability varies

work.math: The UK Erith 12-month quote is £39.72 upfront = £3.31 a month before tax. The no-commit price is unknown. VPS-1 has 2 vCores, 4 GB and 40 GB. Builds are self-managed.

The UK Erith 12-month quote is £39.72 divided by 12 = £3.31 a month before tax. The no-commit price is unknown. 2 vCores and 4 GB meet the minimum. 100 GB is below the APAC 500 GB quota. Capacity is untested.
12-month UK quote: £3.31 a month for the VPS + £0.96 for Premium backup with 7 restore points. The no-commit price and off-site database dumps that match the database state are unknown.
